title: Collect AD graph data
description: Gathers AD relationships for BloodHound. Import the JSON to map attack paths.
output: JSON files to drag into the BloodHound GUI to find paths to Domain Admin.

title: Kerberoast service accounts
description: Requests TGS tickets for SPN accounts. Crack the hashes offline for service creds.
output: TGS hashes ($krb5tgs$) ready for hashcat mode 13100.

title: AS-REP roast
description: Targets accounts without Kerberos pre-auth. No password needed to request the hash.

title: Pass-the-hash shell
description: Authenticate with an NT hash instead of a password. SYSTEM shell via SMB.
output: An interactive SYSTEM shell on the target when the hash is valid.

title: Remote command execution
description: Runs commands on a remote Windows host over SMB with valid creds, an interactive cmd.exe shell (psexec-style, works without a domain).
output: An interactive Windows shell on the target as the supplied user.

title: Pass-the-hash shell (winexe)
description: Authenticate with an NTLM hash instead of a password to get a remote cmd.exe, no cracking needed. Part of the passing-the-hash suite.
output: A remote shell using only the hash, when it is valid on the target.
